issues.title: Cannot add new Countries or ORBATs (FEs) to existing COAs
issues.body:
When we add a COA, we are able to add countries and ORBATs.

But, if we are assigned that COA to make edits, when we view the existing COA we can make changes to all fields, but we are not offered buttons to add/remove Countries or Force Elements.

This is a significant bug, which we need to resolve quickly.

Ok,  this just happens in one situation: 
1. We're a Blue Player looking at Blue COAs.
2. We see an unallocated COA
3. We "Claim" the COA
4. The COA switches to edit mode, but the "array control" buttons aren't enabled

I _Think_ the issue is that `setupEditor()` isn't being called when we switch from "Unallocated" to "Being Edited".  The `editDoc` value seems to update correctly, but we don't see `setupEditor()` get called.
